name: harness-review
title: Harness Review
description: Review current-project changes with a whole-repository Fresh pass when no new findings appear, automatically restarting when local files change. Use /harness-review or /hn-review with list, run, or explicit review options. Overlaps with pr-review on general review and differential-review on security; PR URLs delegate to pr-review.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.
